-- Accepts only a bare file name: no separators, no "..", not empty.
is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool =
  post out == False or name.char_count() > 0
  ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
  ex is_plain_name("../secret") == False
  name.char_count() > 0 and name.split("/").len() == 1 and name.split("\\").len() == 1 and name.split("..").len() == 1

-- Reads one note from the confined fs. A missing or unreadable file gives "".
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  pre is_plain_name(name)
  ex read_note("no-such-file.txt") == ""
  fs.read(name) else ""

-- Counts the names whose note reads as non-empty. Each name is checked
-- first, and every read happens under fs.sub("notes").
count_readable(names: List[str]) -> int uses fs =
  post out >= 0 and out <= names.len()
  ex count_readable(["no-such-file.txt", "../secret"]) == 0
  var n = 0
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    for name in names
      if is_plain_name(name)
        if read_note(name) != ""
          n += 1
  n
